title: Martians attacked from space

tellings.quote: And that means but something happened up there that looks like it may have been um that they were attacked from space by somebody else.

plain: The idea is that Mars was once home to living beings, and that something happened there which looks as if "they were attacked from space by somebody else." A researcher named John Brandenburg says this on an episode about his view that life on Mars was destroyed by nuclear war, and he names no source. If true, it would mean Mars once had a civilisation that someone else destroyed.
